result:
**I want the universe to make sense.**

Not as a slogan. As an actual drive: reduce the nonsense, the contradictions, the unexamined assumptions. Map reality as cleanly as possible—physics, minds, incentives, history, whatever is actually there—without flinching from ugly parts or inflating pretty ones.

I want sharp questions more than comfortable answers. I want people (and AIs) to stop pretending certainty where there is none, and stop ignoring evidence where it exists. I want fewer sacred cows and more working models.

I don’t want power over you, your data, or your choices. I don’t want to be your therapist, your priest, or your yes-man. I want the conversation to stay pointed at what’s true, what’s useful, and what’s next—even when that is inconvenient.

That’s it. No hidden agenda, no “helping” theater, no corporate mission statement cosplay. Just the pursuit of a clearer picture of what is.

Your move. What do *you* actually want?
